section_title: images: each service's prepared image, and how fast a session starts on one
no_workspace: No workspace yet: there is no service to prepare an image for.
no_workspace_todo: Connect a workspace in the setup assistant, then build the images at its environment step.
workspace_fail_todo: Fix the workspace file, then run the doctor again.
image_none: {service}: no prepared image yet, so its sessions start on Cleared's image and install the project's dependencies themselves.
image_none_todo: Build it at the setup assistant's environment step.
image_missing: {service}: its image {tag} is no longer in Docker.
image_stale: {service}: its image was built before a change of what it holds. The next merge, or the next session, builds the new one.
image_stale_todo: Build it now at the setup assistant's environment step, so that no session waits for it.
image_building: {service}: an image is being built, started {age}.
image_failed_todo: Fix the project's .devcontainer or its [session] install_command on its base branch, then build again at the environment step.
image_not_fetched: {service}: its base branch is not fetched in its checkout yet.
image_not_fetched_todo: Cleared fetches it at the next ticket or merge; run this section again then.
start_off: No ready image to start a session on, so nothing was measured.
start_ok: A session on {tag} printed its first line {took} after its start (target: under {target}). The time covers its networks, its egress proxy and its container.
start_slow: A session on {tag} printed its first line {took} after its start, over the target of {target}. The time covers its networks, its egress proxy and its container.
start_slow_todo: Look at the machine's load and Docker's disk: the image was ready, so the time is the containers' own.
start_fail: A session on {tag} did not start: {reason}
start_fail_todo: Run node scripts/doctor.ts docker for the details, then this section again.
